Denkm. sus Abess. 80 ); — Qal 435 Perfect ׳ע Gen 19:27 +, 3 feminine singular עָֽמְדָה 2Kin 13:6 +, etc.; Imperfect יַעֲמֹד Exod 21:21 , יַעֲמוֺד Nahum 1:6 +, יַעֲמָדֿ 1Sam 16:22 +; 1 singular אֶעֱמֹ֑דָה Hab 2:1 , וָאֶעֱמֹד 2Sam 1:10 ; 3 masculine plural יַעַמְדוּ Jer 32:14 +, יַעֲמֹ֑דוּ Ezek 1:21 +, 2 masculine plural וַתַּעַמְדוּן Deut 4:11 , etc.; Imperative עֲמֹד 1Sam 9:27 +, עֲמָדֿ 2Sam 1:9 ; feminine singular עִמְדִי Isa 47:12 ; Jer 48:19 , etc.; Infinitive absolute עָמֹד Est 9:16 ; construct עֲמֹד Exod 18:23 +, suffix עָמְדִי Jer 18:20 , עֲמָדְךָ Obadiah 11, etc.; Participle עֹמֵד Isa 3:13 +, feminine עֹמֶ֫דֶת Hag 2:5 +, etc.; — 1. a. take one's stand , and (especially participle) stand, be in a standing attitude: with עַל by , 1Sam 26:13 ; 2Sam 2:25 ; 2Kin 2:7 +, so participle Gen 18:8 (J), 41:1 , 17 (E) +, עַל on , Exod 3:5 (E), Deut 27:12 +; with ב location Exod 32:26 ; Num 22:24 , 26 (all J E), +; with אֶל location 1Kin 20:38 (+ לְ person), Jer 48:19 ; Ezek 21:26 ; 27:29 ; with אֶל person 1Sam 17:51 ; 2Kin 5:25 ; with אֵצֶל Gen 41:3 (E), Ezek 9:2 ; 10:6 ; Neh 8:4 ; with לִפְנֵי Gen 18:22 ; 1Kin 3:16 ; 8:22 +; before ׳י , for intercession Gen 19:27 (J), Deut 4:10 ; Jer 15:1 ; 18:20 , etc.; take one's stand and do a thing 1Sam 17:8 ; 1Kin 8:55 ; 2Kin 18:28 = Isa 36:13 +; followed by infinitive 1Kin 8:11 2Chr 5:14 +. b. stand forth (to speak, etc.) 2Kin 10:9 +. c. take a stand against ( עַל ), in opposition to, Judg 6:31 ; Ezra 10:15 (but stand over, = have charge of, according to Kue Ges. Abh. 247 f. ) 2Chr 26:18 ; compare עַלדַּֿם Lev 19:16 (H) against the blood of , i.e. seek one's blood, life; with יָ֑חַד Isa 50:8 together , i.e. against each other. d. present oneself before ( לִפְנֵי ) Gen 43:15 (J), Exod 9:10 (E), Num 27:2 , 21 (P), 1Sam 16:21 +; before ׳י (in sanctuary) Deut 19:17 ; Jer 7:10 ; compare 18:20 ; Lev 9:5 (P); so in heaven 1Kin 22:21 2Chr 18:20 ; with ב location of child at birth Hosea 13:13 , in palace (as retainer, courtier) Dan 1:4 e. with לִפְנֵי attend upon, be(come) servant of 1Sam 16:22 (see Dr), 1Kin 1:2 +; servant of ׳י 17:1 ; 18:15 ; 2Kin 3:14 ; 5:16 ; Jer 15:19 ; priests י (לְשָֽׁרְתוֺׅ׳לִפְנֵי Deut 10:8 ; Judg 20:28 ; Ezek 44:15 ; 2Chr 29:11 ; of Levites, stand before congregation for menial duties Ezek 44:11 ; Num 16:9 (P). f. stand afar מֵרָחוֺק Exod 20:18 , 21 (E), Isa 59:14 ; Psa 38:12 , ׳בְּר 10:1 ; מֵר ׳מִנֶּגֶד 2Kin 2:7 ; stand aloof, מִנֶֹּגֶד Obadiah 11; Psa 38:12 . g. stand (silent) Job 32:16 . h. stand (appealingly) Job 30:20 (but read עָמַדְתָּ , of God, Me Hi Du). i. stand , subject רֶגֶל Zech 14:4 ( עַל location), Psa 122:2 ( ב location) so 26:12 (figurative). j. stand , of water, עַלהָֿרִים Psa 104:6 . See also prepositions עִם מִמַּעַל, עַל, אֵצֶל, אֶל, , etc. 2. a. stand still, stop , cease moving, of moon Josh 10:13 (J E; || וַיִּדֹּם ), sun 10:13 , both, Hab 3:11 ; of person 1Sam 9:27 (opposed to עָבַר ), 2Sam 2:28 (opposed to רָדַף ), עֲמֹ֫דוּ עִמְדוּ Nahum 2:9 +; stop flowing (of oil) 2Kin 4:6 ; remain standing , with תַּחְתֵּינוּ Judg 7:21 ; 1Sam 14:9 etc.; of eruption in skin = remain unchanged Lev 13:23 , 28 ; so (without ׳ת ) 13:5 , 37 (all P). b. = be inactive 2Chr 20:17 (opposed to לְהִלָּחֵם , + הִתְיַצְּבוּ ). c. = be attentive Job 37:14 . d. stop, cease doing a thing 2Kin 13:18 ; with מִן Gen 29:35 ; 30:9 (both J), Joel 1:15 . 3. a. tarry, delay Gen 45:9 (E), Josh 10:19 (J E; opposed to רָדַף ), 1Sam 20:38 (opposed to חוּשָׁה מְהֵרָה, ), +. b. remain , with ב location 2Kin 15:20 ; Deut 10:10 ; with עִמָּדִי 5:28 (opposed to שׁוּב ); + infinitive purpose Est 7:7 . c. continue, abide Jer 32:14 ; Isa 66:22 ; Psa 102:27 (opposed to אָבַד ); = dwell Exod 8:18 (J; עַל location); לָעַד Psa 19:10 ; 111:3 ; 111:10 ; 112:3 ; 112:9 ; לְעוֺלָם 33:11 ; Eccl 1:4 ; בְּתוֺךְ Hag 2:5 ; of plan = be established Psa 33:11 (earlier קוּם , as Isa 14:24 ), so Est 3:4 ; Dan 11:17 b; = maintain itself (earlier קוּם Josh 2:11 ) Eccl 2:9 ; כֹחַ יַעֲמָדבִּֿי לֹא Dan 10:17 . d. endure Exod 18:23 (E), Ezek 22:14 (|| חָזַק ). e. be steadfast Deut 25:8 ; Ruth 2:7 . f. persist Eccl 8:3 . 4 make a stand, hold one's ground , Amos 2:15 ; 2Kin 10:4 ; Mal 3:2 +; with לִפְנֵי Judg 2:14 ; 2Kin 10:4 +, בִּפְנֵי Josh 10:8 ; 21:44 (Ginsb; van d. H. Baer 21:42 ), 23:9 (all D); with עַל , for one's life Est 8:11 ; 9:16 . 5 stand upright: a. remain standing 2Kin 13:6 ; of head 6:31 remain upright upon him ( עָלָיו ); of house (figurative of endurance) Job 8:15 ; Prov 12:7 . b. stand up , opposed to sit, Neh 8:5 ; Job 29:8 (+ קוּם ); opposed to lie prostrate Ezek 2:1 ( עַלרַֿגְלֶיךָ ), so 37:10 ( id. ), Dan 10:1 , 10:11 ( עַלעָֿמְדָ֑ךָ ), Est 8:4 ; of revival after death Dan 12:13 (late for קוּם ). c. stand up, rise , of water Josh 3:13 (+ appositive אֶחָד נֵד ), 3:16 (+ קָמוּ + id. ; both J E). d. be erect, upright , of boards Exod 26:15 ; 36:20 (P). 6. a. arise, appear, come on the scene (= קוּם ; late) Ezra 2:63 = Neh 7:65 ; Psa 106:30 (compare Ecclus 47:1; Ecclus 47:12), especially Dan 8:22 (twice in verse); 8:23 ; 11:2-3 , 4 ; 12:1 , compare 11:7 ( כַּנּוֺ ), 11:20 ; 11:21 ( עַלכַּֿנּוֺ ); with תַּחַת instead of Eccl 4:15 ; of war 1Chr 20:4 , deliverance Est 4:14 . b. stand forth, appear = come into being Isa 48:13 ; Psa 33:9 ; 119:90 . c. rise up as foe (earlier קום Amos 7:9 ; Gen 4:8 ), with עַל against 1Chr 21:1 ; 2Chr 20:23 ; Dan 8:25 ; 11:14 , c. לְנֶגְדִּי against Dan 10:13 . 7 rare usages are: a. ׳ע אֶתֿ stand with , as attendant, servitor Gen 45:1 (E), Num 1:5 (P). b. take one's stand in covenant, בַּבְּרִית 2Kin 23:3 . c. stand עַלחֶֿרֶב Ezek 33:26 (resort to the sword). d. stand י ׳בְּסוֺד Jer 23:18 , 22 (see סוֺד ). e. be appointed Ezra 10:14 . f. stand before ( לִפְנֵי ) beast Lev 18:23 (carnal intercourse) g. grow flat, insipid (Gie), taste of wine Jer 48:11 (figurative of Moab), or remain unchanged (so most, in that case compare 3b ). — עָמְדִי Dan 11:1 b is corrupt, read probably עָמַדְתִּי , or עָמַד ( מִיכָאֵל subject), join then to 10:21 and strike out 11:1 a; so Bev Behrm Marti Kau .
